source.environment: isolated headless Chromium with pinned task assets

protocol.policy_observation: visible goal, visible control text and metadata, and six recent actions; no screenshot pixels to the text model
protocol.action_space: visible control click or popup hover
protocol.success: task terminal and raw reward exactly 1
protocol.reset_check: independent model and baseline episodes start with the same DOM, visible controls, and 16x16 visual-feature hash
protocol.reporting: atomic checkpoint after each completed paired episode

runs.name: qwen3_5_2b_navigation_previous_protocol
runs.caveat: Earlier probe revision did not re-read delayed terminal reward after settling and used strict bare-index parsing. It produced successful terminal rewards but is not protocol-identical to the corrected six-family run.

runs.name: qwen3_5_2b_interrupted_attempts
runs.failure: CUDA illegal-instruction errors during Transformers Qwen3.5 attention fallback; Windows logged nvlddmkm IDs 13 and 153 at matching times. A small CUDA tensor still succeeded afterward. Root trigger not established; incomplete runs are not scored as full evaluations.

finding: The corrected local 0.6B text model completes some synthetic multi-step tasks but trails a simple goal-order baseline on five of six task families. The 2B model finished one smaller navigation-only run without exceeding the baseline, then repeatedly crashed the GPU driver path on wider attempts. Neither result supports Jev parity or live desktop promotion.
limitations: These are seed holdouts within task families that were explored during probe development, not independent task-family or preregistered evaluations.
The baseline and model share a heuristic action filter that can exclude revisiting a control, so this is not an unbiased measure of general web automation.
The model sees structured controls and goal text, not screen pixels; the 16x16 visual hash is only a reset check.
No real Heliox desktop task, safety gate, approval path, physical action, or Jev behavior was validated.
Local raw episode reports are ignored research artifacts and are not shipped with this summary.
